stem: Which age group is covered for clinician prescribing of ADHD medication in children in NSW?
explanation: The correct age range is 4-17 years, which is the age group covered for clinician prescribing of ADHD medication in children in NSW.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 85

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because this age range is not the one stated in the NSW prescribing notes.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because the notes state that clinician prescribing of ADHD medication in children in NSW applies to ages 4-17 years.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because the age limits do not match the stated 4-17 years range.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because this is not the age range specified in the notes.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the notes do not support ADHD medication prescribing from birth.
